category: Define Security Requirements for AI Systems (PO)
subcategory_text: Identify and document the security requirements specific to AI systems, including model integrity, training-data provenance, evaluation rigour, and downstream harm mitigation, in addition to conventional software-security requirements.
implementation_examples: Document model-security requirements (e.g., resistance to prompt injection, model theft)
Document data-security requirements (training-data provenance, PII handling)
Document evaluation requirements (robustness, fairness, hallucination tests)
assessment_objectives: Determine whether AI-specific security requirements are documented in addition to traditional security requirements.
Determine whether requirements address model integrity, data provenance, and downstream harm.
